purpose: Audit cache and advisory-store geometry of the accepted f091 FPGA package from its exact recorded source revisions and default static configuration. Separate source inference from actual FFC elaborated constants and historical L2-only capacity controls; no build, target execution or board I/O occurred.

accepted_package.basis: recorded static CFG, default NUM_THREADS/NUM_CONTEXTS flags; no independent routed geometry elaboration recovered

L1I.scope: per core, shared by physical/logical contexts

L1D.scope: per core, shared by physical/logical contexts

I_advisory.scope: one shared cache-local store per core, not per resident/logical context

D_advisory.scope: TOTAL per core/cache instance, shared across all resident and logical contexts

D_transport_source_conditions.interpretation: full_line0 selects a16-byte BedRock read; narrow response words are forwarded at base+(fill_count<<3), so this is two8-byte logical response beats, not a64-byte UCE forward of which16bytes are retained.
D_transport_source_conditions.physical_preview_ingress: Only directCSR0x9c0 enters UCE.preview_v, sets prefetch_preview_r=1, and discards narrow replies. Tagged physical replay is a separate ingress.
D_transport_source_conditions.routing_under_default_flags: top_zynq derives prefetch_axi_bypass=0 for selected four-entry namedCFG; only5/10CFG or explicit BP_PREFETCH_AXI_BYPASS enables direct bypass. Therefore default narrow D requests traverse normal L2 routing.
D_transport_source_conditions.lower_hierarchy_limit: An ordinary L2miss may allocate/fetch a64-byte block. No physical AXI transaction count, DRAM byte count, latency, L2pressure or bandwidth cost is established by this source audit.
D_transport_source_conditions.tagged_replay_ingress: CSR0x9c1/9c2 configure controller;CSR0x9c3 (explicitLinuxPR0x42505060) triggers slot. Controller→PMA→pipe_mem e_dcache_op_prefetch with supplied physical ptag→Dcache e_cache_prefetch→UCE prefetch_allocate sets preview_r=0→narrow e_cache_data_mem_prefetch replies can fill global64B D advisory store. Physical-address input does not imply direct-preview reply discard.
D_transport_source_conditions.l2_allocation_source: Defaultbypass0 routes bothnarrowDingresses toL2. bp_me_cache_controller.sv:556-569 maps16Bmem_rd toLM; recordedBaseJump3dff9f43 bsg_cache_decode.sv:43-51 makesLMaload; bsg_cache_miss.sv:324-337 choosesway andblockalignedDMAfill;455-490fillsdataandpublishestagvalid. This is an allocating normalL2load path, not measuredtraffic.
D_transport_source_conditions.source_claim_limit: Tagged can populate sidebuffer and allocate L2; source alone does not prove how much is resident atfirstuse, actualsidehits, AXIbytes, interference or performanceattribution. UCEdrainedstatus isnotadvisorywordvalidoccupancy.

explicit_trigger.csr: 0x9c3 = slot when enabled; no write when disabled

direct_preview.source_path: UCE preview_v input only; preview_r=1; replies discarded

kernel_prctl_routes.selector_limit: 0x9c3 bit2 selects instruction follow behavior, not direct-preview versus advisory-store ingress

L1I.scope: per core, shared by physical/logical contexts

L1D.scope: per core, shared by physical/logical contexts

ffc_actual_comparison.normal_baseline_only: Existing analyzer rejects any accepted prefetch_req or consumed side_hit, and validated only normal-cache references/refills. Its result does not exercise D advisory storage or prove a side-capacity benefit.
ffc_actual_comparison.mapping_difference: Same L2 totalbytes does not mean same bankmapping/concurrency; acceptedstatic2x16 differs from FFC1x32. Also acceptedD64B differs from FFC32B.

historical_RL106.claim_limit: Directed L2 retention difference only. Does not establish L1D capacity, D advisory retention, I advisory capacity, application speedup, or geometry of the accepted f091 route. Namedstatic16KiBendpoint is a separate smoke, not selectedCFG4.

findings: Acceptedstatic source resolves32KiB L1I and32KiB L1D; any16KiB L1 label is unsupported by these exactobjects.
Acceptedstatic source resolves4KiB L2(two16-setbanks), not the unselected16KiB L2endpoint.
D64B is global retained payload, not percontext, and must not be multiplied by UCEslots, replayaddresscounts, or logicalcontextcount.
Logical16B D replies do not establish physical memory traffic; lower-level allocation and interference need traces.
Source-inferred acceptedFPGA parameters remain separate from actual FFC waveform elaborated parameters.
